subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram channel — send multiple image attachments as a media group (album) instead of sequential sendPhoto calls

question: Should the bundled Telegram channel automatically group compatible multi-image message-tool attachments into albums, and what should the supported behavior be for captions, replies/threads, mixed media, and batches exceeding Telegram’s group limit?
rationale: The change is user-visible and alters the existing per-image message contract; source evidence shows no established repository policy for these edge cases.

options.title: Adopt a narrow image-album contract
options.body: Group only 2–10 all-image attachments, put the caption on the first item, preserve reply/thread parameters, and retain individual sends everywhere else.

options.title: Keep individual sends
options.body: Retain current transport behavior until a broader cross-channel attachment-presentation policy is defined.

options.title: Design broader media grouping
options.body: Define mixed-media and over-limit chunking behavior before implementation, accepting a larger compatibility and test surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow image-album contract
recommendation.body: Group only 2–10 all-image attachments, put the caption on the first item, preserve reply/thread parameters, and retain individual sends everywhere else.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the closest evidence-backed prior investigation into Telegram album behavior, although current-main feature ownership remains unconfirmed.
